name: Nosa Plugs AB
summary: Nosa Plugs AB, a medical technology firm, specializes in developing and marketing intranasal respiratory aids, predominantly across Europe and North America. Their NOSA product portfolio encompasses various solutions: odor control devices for protection against unpleasant smells; microbial control products engineered to diminish the inhalation of viruses and bacteria through the nose; and allergy filters designed to screen out detrimental airborne matter like pollen, pet dander, dust, and mold. The company, established in 2014, is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
